images.caption: A formation of 88th Air Base Wing Airmen stand at parade rest during the wing change of command ceremony July 14 at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio. Col. Bradley D. Spacy, succeeded Col. Colleen Ryan at the ceremony, held in a World War Two-era hangar overlooking the flightline in Area C.
images.alt: A formation of 88th Air Base Wing Airmen stand at parade rest during the wing change of command ceremony July 14 at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio. Col. Bradley D. Spacy, succeeded Col. Colleen Ryan at the ceremony, held in a World War Two-era hangar overlooking the flightline in Area C.

images.filename: Air Force officials focus on efficiency improvements 110405-F-AL359-001.jpg
images.caption: Marilyn Thomas discusses the challenges of executing acquisition programs in a constrained budget environment during a presentation to Aeronautical Systems Center employees April 5 at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio. Ms. Thomas spoke at the 2011 Spring Program Review town hall meeting; she is the Deputy for Budget at the Office of the Assistant Secretary of the Air Force for Financial Management and Comptroller. (U.S. Air Force photo/Michelle Gigante)
images.alt: Marilyn Thomas discusses the challenges of executing acquisition programs in a constrained budget environment during a presentation to Aeronautical Systems Center employees April 5 at Wright-Patterson Air Force Base, Ohio. Ms. Thomas spoke at the 2011 Spring Program Review town hall meeting; she is the Deputy for Budget at the Office of the Assistant Secretary of the Air Force for Financial Management and Comptroller. (U.S. Air Force photo/Michelle Gigante)
